digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Rust, TypeScript, Python）和 15 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: openai/codex
repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal

repos.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute

repos.name: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix

repos.summary_zh: 终端常驻的 DeepSeek 原生编码代理，靠前缀缓存稳定实现零重启连续开发

repos.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.
repos.summary_zh: 前端测试界的瑞士军刀，让浏览器里的任何东西都能快速可靠地自动化验证，开发者体验拉满

repos.description: A runtime for writing reliable asynchronous applications with Rust. Provides I/O, networking, scheduling, timers, ...
repos.summary_zh: Rust 异步编程的事实标准运行时，提供高效 I/O 与任务调度，让可靠并发应用开发更简单

repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
